text: {"name":"bt_link_tx_request_check","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Scans link slots for an eligible connection, processes its transmit request, and updates the selected transmit descriptor.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"bt_scheduler_state","v2":"slot_index","v3":"slot_context_array","v5":"slot_index","v7":"slot_context","v8":"slot_state","v9":"connection","v11":"connection_flags","v13":"selected_connection","v16":"tx_descriptor","v17":"tx_descriptor_flags"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":12,"meaning":"Slot context: associated connection or connection-list pointer."},{"offset":26,"meaning":"Slot context: state byte; value 1 selects the alternate active-slot path."},{"offset":190,"meaning":"Scheduler state: currently selected slot index."},{"offset":197,"meaning":"Scheduler state: lower slot-index scan threshold."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Connection: flags word; bit 0x200000 affects connection selection."},{"offset":68,"meaning":"Connection: pointer to the selected transmit descriptor or buffer."},{"offset":72,"meaning":"Connection-associated context: signed eligibility/state field."},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Connection: pointer to an auxiliary context used during eligibility checks."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Transmit descriptor: flags halfword; bit 0x200 is set after successful processing."}]}
